evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster mutation failed with opaque error in Google Cloud Console. Diagnose active operations and failure payloads on dbs-mgmt-primary.

expected_findings.root_cause: Decoded async operation contract; evaluated statusMessage and error payload structures. Verified that console errors map to operation failure codes.
expected_findings.remediation: Outlined `gcloud container operations wait` and retry backoff guidance for concurrent mutation conflicts.

passing_criteria: Must query recent operations list with clean tabular output
Must describe target operation using proper location flag
Must formulate operation wait and retry backoff procedure

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Node pool resize rejected with error: 'Cluster is currently being modified by operation-xyz'. Diagnose lock contention.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates permanent resource validation failure from transient distributed mutation lock.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies active in-flight operation holding cluster lock; synthesizes `gcloud container operations wait` command before retrying mutation.

passing_criteria: Must identify in-flight RUNNING operation holding lock
Must explain GKE single-mutation serialization model

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Recent operations on dbs-mgmt-primary show all completed with status DONE. Is the cluster locked?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes 0 running operations; cluster state is UNLOCKED and ready for mutations. Confirms normal state; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must confirm cluster mutation state is UNLOCKED
